title: `topics/the-second-person-evidential-channel` equivocates between second-person *neuroscience* (third-person study of interacting subjects) and second-person *evidence* (the participant's knowing-by-engagement); downstream, the Tenet 3 paragraph reads interactionism into evidence that is neutral between interactionism/epiphenomenalism/physicalism, and L73 asserts as a premise ("none reducible to the others") the irreducibility L61 holds as a hypothesis
